summary.intent: Unlock TurboQuant KV cache compression on a Framework Desktop with Strix Halo (gfx1151) iGPU, picking up from a prior session that had completed BIOS changes and schema/oracle code.
summary.outcome: Discovered that 0xSero/turboquant v0.2.0 with Triton kernels is already installed and integrated into the cohezion codebase, but not yet smoke-tested on gfx1151. The session ended with a clear next action: run a targeted Triton dispatch test to determine if the kernel-ISA gap from session 94 is still blocking.

workflow: Gmail MCP create_draft is a practical alternative to SMTP for reboot handoffs: no credential management, human reviews before sending, available even when GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD is unset
llama.cpp default -fit on hangs at 99% CPU for large models on this host; always use -fit off flag
llama.cpp model buffers land in GTT (shared system memory) not VRAM on UMA APUs — rocm-smi VRAM Used stays flat while GTT Used grows; this is normal behavior
kernel.ubuntu.com/mainline build failures are common for specific minor versions (6.18.4 had no .deb); always check the directory listing before citing a version in a plan

cappelikan/ppa (mainline kernel GUI) adds a persistent apt source; requires explicit user consent distinct from 'upgrade kernel' — direct .deb from kernel.ubuntu.com is the lower-trust-footprint alternative
The PyTorch ROCm wheel ISA gap for gfx1151 is orthogonal to kernel/driver upgrades — it requires PyTorch to ship updated wheels with gfx1151 ISA support
